M-CONTEXT.Purpose: Turn semantic ancestors of actual reads into one ordered agent-facing context document and deliver it per scope.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Ordered ancestry from narrow implementation toward broader architectural meaning.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Delivery: scope-keyed cross-event suppression and reset operations.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Speculative relevance, task invention, replacement of the read file.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Cross-event/session dedup outside Delivery; hidden-context reconstruction.

Requirements.REQ-001: Only resolved semantic ancestors are injected; actual-read files are excluded from injected ancestors.
Requirements.REQ-002: Multi-read produces the union of ancestors, deduplicated, ancestor-first; a canonical ancestor appears at most once per read group per project-qualified identity.
Requirements.REQ-003: Ancestor content is strict UTF-8: an invalid byte sequence is a diagnostic plus branch exclusion, never replacement-character corruption; valid UTF-8 including BOM is preserved; a CDATA terminator is split safely without semantic loss.
Requirements.REQ-004: Relevant processing uses current source content; derived state cannot supply stale canonical content.
Requirements.REQ-005: Absolute filesystem paths are never exposed; document identity is the project-qualified path with a project discriminator for equal project-relative paths across projects.
Requirements.REQ-006: The envelope is `<frostline-context>` with project-relative path-derived kebab-case entries; a normalization collision adds an identity suffix; each closing tag identifies its document.
Requirements.REQ-007: There is no FLI semantic budget or silent context pruning.
Requirements.REQ-008: Delivery dedup requires a reliable opaque `DeliveryScope`; reset context/session clears suppression without touching semantic truth.

Inputs.IN-001: Observed read paths within a read group.
Inputs.IN-002: Delivery scope identifier and reset operations.

Outputs.OUT-001: `ContextDocument[]` and rendered context string for non-empty newly delivered sets.
Outputs.OUT-002: No output for empty or already-delivered context.
